purpose: Platform-enforced trusted runner isolation for the real-VFP9 acceptance lane, plus the explicit TWO-STAGE acceptance lifecycle. This file is a REQUIRED-CONFIGURATION SPECIFICATION, NOT evidence: it does not prove that GitHub is configured this way and it does not prove any execution. Objective proof can only come from verifying the live GitHub runner-group configuration (GitHub REST API / organization settings) plus a real dispatched workflow run on protected main.

canonical_selected_workflow.placeholder_note: FINAL_OWNER is deliberately unset because the repository ownership/topology decision has not been made. Before any live verification, the platform owner must replace the placeholder with the actual owner in the live runner-group configuration; the repository never guesses it.
canonical_selected_workflow.github_note: GitHub runner-group workflow restrictions require a fully qualified workflow identity (owner/repository/path@ref); the template above corresponds to that format.

stage_a_pre_merge_repository_evidence.purpose: Repository-side enabling evidence. The trusted workflow is workflow_dispatch-only and GitHub accepts dispatch events ONLY when the workflow file exists on the default branch; therefore the enabling merge is the ONLY legal way to place the lane where it can later be dispatched. This resolves the acceptance-sequencing deadlock without weakening any security property.
enabling_merge_allowed_when: the trusted workflow is version-controlled on this PR branch
all repository structural security tests pass (tests/test_p7_ci_contract.py)
runner targeting is fail-closed (runner group + labels bound to authoritative repository variables; no committed literal group/label)
no unsafe repository-level self-hosted runner is registered
all hosted/public mandatory gates are green on the exact PR HEAD
ordinary PR code cannot use the trusted lane from any checked-in workflow
this specification still states that external platform configuration is NOT PROVEN
stage_a_pre_merge_repository_evidence.requirement_remains_partial_after_enabli: REQ-P7-006 remains PARTIAL/BLOCKED after the enabling merge

stage_b_post_merge_external_acceptance.purpose: Trusted acceptance evidence, obtainable ONLY after the enabling merge placed the workflow on the default branch.
required_after_enabling_merge: PM-controlled GitHub ownership/topology provides an organization or enterprise runner group, or an objectively equivalent platform isolation
live runner-group configuration is verified from GitHub (API/settings): repository access allowlisted to exactly the intended DBF_Anonymizer repository
public-repository access, if applicable, is deliberate
workflow access is restricted_to_workflows with exactly the canonical selected workflow pinned to refs/heads/main
only after platform verification may the runner-group variables be populated
only then may workflow_dispatch be used on protected main
real Visual FoxPro 9 executes with no acceptance skip

REQ-P6-003/P7-006 evidence is obtained: source immutability; staging and published reopen; record count; tag inventory; sanitized evidence; exact commit identity; no untrusted PR code on the trusted runner
stage_b_post_merge_external_acceptance.full_pass_only_when: every item of acceptance_requires_all_of is objectively satisfied

lifecycle.removed_instruction: The previous unconditional 'do not merge while trusted-VFP execution evidence is missing' is RETIRED: it created an impossible closure (workflow_dispatch legally requires the workflow on the default branch first). The enabling merge must not be confused with acceptance: it changes NO status of the requirement itself.

layer_1_platform_authorization.group_membership: self-hosted Windows runner dedicated to Visual FoxPro 9 acceptance

repository_access.owner_placeholder_note: FINAL_OWNER is deliberately unset until the repository ownership/topology decision is made; it must not be guessed.
repository_access.default_scope_note: By default private repositories only can access a runner group; public access must be granted explicitly and deliberately.

workflow_access.equivalent_platform_isolation: acceptable only if it provably prevents every other workflow file - including future PR-modified files - from scheduling jobs on the trusted runner

layer_1_platform_authorization.verification_procedure: After provisioning, verify through GitHub configuration APIs/settings (runner group exists; repository allowlist == the single DBF_Anonymizer repository; workflow allowlist exactly the canonical selected workflow pinned to refs/heads/main) and only then dispatch the trusted workflow on protected main to produce execution evidence.

layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.ref_guard: refs/heads/main only, verified before any checkout
layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.checkout: no explicit ref and no caller-provided SHA/branch; never github.event.pull_request.head.sha
layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.revision_identity: git rev-parse HEAD must equal origin/main and be recorded with the sanitized evidence
layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.acceptance_tool: tools/run_real_vfp9_acceptance.py (the established REQ-P6-003 boundary; no second acceptance protocol)

runner_targeting.syntax: runs-on mapping with group and labels
runner_targeting.fail_closed: while either variable is unset the job cannot be scheduled and the lane produces no evidence

layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.environment_approvals: NOT a substitute for the runner-group boundary (an attacker-controlled workflow could omit the environment)

stable_topology_constraints.note: Normative facts that hold under the CURRENT topology and must be re-evaluated when ownership/topology changes.

external_observation.note: Point-in-time observation with provenance; NOT_LIVE_EVIDENCE — do not treat as continuously valid GitHub state. Volatile counts belong here, never among normative facts.

acceptance_requires_all_of: platform-level runner access isolation (runner group allowlisting only this repository)
workflow access restricted to the dedicated trusted VFP workflow (canonical fully-qualified template, pinned to refs/heads/main)
trusted workflow pinned to protected main
runner-group policy verified from live GitHub configuration
a real workflow_dispatch run on protected main
record count / tag inventory proved per accepted P6-003 evidence
no untrusted PR code executed on the trusted machine
until_then: REQ-P7-006 remains PARTIAL/BLOCKED. Stage A (the enabling merge of this repository work) is PERMITTED once the stage_a conditions hold and does NOT constitute PASS. P7-007 remains blocked until full Stage B pass. Do NOT register a repository-level self-hosted runner as a workaround.
